profile.bio: I turn complex problems into simple, useful digital experiences. From the first sketch to the last API endpoint, I care about the details that make software feel right.
profile.about:
I'm a developer who enjoys working at the intersection of thoughtful design and dependable engineering. I build accessible interfaces, well-structured APIs, and products that people enjoy using.

Away from the keyboard, you'll find me exploring new places, collecting ideas, and looking for the next interesting problem.
